name: macos-phishing-assessment
title: Phishing Assessment
description: Browser extensions, protection settings, proxy/DNS/hosts tampering and risky downloads

checks.title: Browser extensions (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Safari)
command: for root in "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Google/Chrome" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Microsoft Edge" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/BraveSoftware/Brave-Browser"; do
find "$root" -maxdepth 4 -path '*/Extensions/*' -name manifest.json 2>/dev/null | while read -r m; do

checks.title: Gatekeeper, proxy, DNS and hosts overrides
Recent quarantined downloads and risky files
command: sqlite3 "$HOME/Library/Preferences/com.apple.LaunchServices.QuarantineEventsV2" "select datetime(LSQuarantineTimeStamp + 978307200, 'unixepoch'), LSQuarantineAgentName, LSQuarantineOriginURLString from LSQuarantineEvent order by LSQuarantineTimeStamp desc limit 15" 2>/dev/null
